profile_resolutions.decision: Proximal entry edge for source new-POI/Breaker/Range retest; STB midpoint. Round inside POI to instrument tick. Selects one source-permitted limit price, never a market fill.
profile_resolutions.rationale: Smallest explicit quote convention; no optimized intrazone offset.

profile_resolutions.decision: Non-Range opposing POI proximal edge, first along direction; tied price preserves all IDs. Range target smallest tick strictly inside opposite source boundary, or nearer explicit source-defined contextual FTA supplied by Range exit evidence; both80/20 at that same price.
profile_resolutions.rationale: Minimum representable inside distance; no fitted near-boundary percentage.

profile_resolutions.decision: Non-SFP strictly beyond source extreme by minimum representable tick; SFP ATR stop round outward to tick, no extra percentage buffer. Instrument tick metadata must be causally known.
profile_resolutions.rationale: An extreme is not a tradable strictly-beyond price without tick convention.

profile_resolutions.decision: SMA of14 True Ranges, 15 contiguous completed pattern-TF bars ending at raid CLOSE. Previous close included; latestOHLC equals pattern. ATR frozen before confirmation and entry.
profile_resolutions.rationale: Request fixes14 bars but not smoother; rolling mean avoids recursive seed/warmup assumptions.

profile_resolutions.decision: SFP manual body invalidation uses completed pattern-TF CLOSE only, strict beyond extreme.
profile_resolutions.rationale: Source does not exhaustively arbitrate all candle TF; pattern-TF convention stated explicitly.

profile_resolutions.decision: SHA256(symbol, contextual structural origin ID, original idea POI canonical ID) physical key; setup key adds direction, formation and confirmation IDs. Evidence adapters must use stable canonical source IDs. Refined entry POI references parent idea POI. Consumed zone and formation cannot be relabelled as new setup. First complete validation event owns plan; no branch token in identity.
profile_resolutions.rationale: Prevents duplicate branch trades without lifetime symbol ban or time cooldown.

profile_resolutions.decision: Evaluate complete same-event branch set; conflict before tie selection. Equivalent plans use earliest validation event; lexical branch label only labels identical-plan provenance. Later conflict blocks new admission and preserves previously observed state.
profile_resolutions.rationale: Total deterministic ordering of equivalent plans, not financial branch ranking.

profile_resolutions.decision: Typed source_validated causal annotations supply meaningful liquidity, tilt, smooth approach, whole impulse, range clarity, protected endpoints and branch confirmation. Missing/future/nonunique evidence waits. No quantitative qualitative classifier claimed. Inventory attestation covers known prefix only.
profile_resolutions.rationale: User explicitly requires WAIT rather than materially arbitrary thresholds.
